description: Talks to Marsell, the project's marketer, in its chat: ask what it is doing and why, or tell it what to change (the week, a post, the plan). Returns Marsell's reply, what it changed, the conversation's id and anything that waits for the owner's press. Prefer the direct tools for a plain read or change; use this for what needs Marsell's judgement or works on a canvas or a video. Marsell uses its own tools, so an answer may take a minute and spends the owner's tokens. With canvas or video, Marsell works on that canvas or video as when the owner has it open: what spends or posts there waits for the owner's press in Marsell's chat, and the answer says so.

part.description: The part picked on it, when one is.

conversation.description: Continue this conversation (the id an earlier answer gave).

message.description: What you say to Marsell, in plain words, as the owner would.

new_conversation.description: Start a fresh conversation instead of continuing the latest.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

video.description: A video, by its channel and episode ids (canvas_film's answer gives them as open).

at.description: The second of the film being talked about.

name: ask_marsell
title: Ask Marsell
